title: EIP-8219: Checked Arithmetic Opcodes
description: Adds opcodes for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division that revert on overflow, underflow, or division by zero
author: Hubert Ritzdorf (@ritzdorf)
laymanDescription: Solidity and Vyper guard every arithmetic operation against overflow by default, but the EVM has no instruction for it, so compilers wrap each one in a multi-instruction check. This proposal adds four opcodes that do the arithmetic and revert on overflow, underflow, or division by zero in a single step.
benefits: Cuts a checked addition from roughly 79 gas to 5, and from 12 bytes to 1
Removes the gas incentive to reach for unchecked blocks where safety is unproven
Self-contained opcodes avoid the hidden flag state earlier proposals would have added
tradeoffs: Consumes four of the EVM's remaining unassigned opcode slots
Covers unsigned 256-bit arithmetic only; signed variants are deferred to a companion EIP
Reverts with empty returndata, so Solidity loses its Panic(0x11) error payload
